Birthday.LetterBody:
Happy Birthday to my forever best friend 🤍 I honestly don't know where I would be without you. You're not just my bestie, you're my safe place, my biggest support, and the person who understands me even when I don't say a word. Every memory with you is so special to me, from our random talks to our deep late-night conversations. You make my life brighter just by being in it.

You've always stood by me in my worst moments and celebrated with me in my happiest ones. That's something really rare, and I'm so lucky to have you. No matter what happens, I promise I'll always be there for you too—through every laugh, every tear, and every crazy moment we share.

On your special day, I pray that you get all the happiness, love, and success you truly deserve. May your life be filled with beautiful moments, endless smiles, and dreams that come true. Stay the amazing, kind, and beautiful soul you are.

I love you more than words can ever express.

Happy Birthday once again, my bestie 🎂💫💖
